name: exilitys-skills
description: Exilitys' agent skills - workflow, context-system and code-explanation tooling. Packaged as Claude Code plugins; installable on any SKILL.md-compatible agent via install.py

plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Set up and maintain a project's agentic context system and coding workflow - the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md layer, the contract gate, the enforcement hooks, and the lane discipline

plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: Explain a code change - diff, branch, commit range or PR - as a single self-contained HTML page with background, intuition, a code walkthrough, diagrams and an interactive quiz
